own.notes: For integer quantity q in 1..1000, select the segment with the greatest from value not exceeding q. Evaluate constant + linear*q + quadratic*q*q in GBP pence, then round to a nonnegative integer. These coefficients already produce positive integer totals. Reconstructed from 96 distinct successful REA observations spanning the full range; all 96 match exactly. After fixing the model and confirming transitions, 72 additional validation quantities all matched exactly: maximum absolute error 0 pence, with 100% observed success under the exact, 1%, and 5% criteria. Adjacent observations at 292, 293, 294 and 749, 750, 751 confirm the slope changes. Confidence is high in this three-segment affine reconstruction, but the remaining 904 quantities were not observed. Validation does not guarantee unseen accuracy or exclude narrow hidden exceptions; the longest consecutive unqueried interval contains 17 quantities.
